_doc: SPINOFF-IDEAS-1 (owner, 2026-11-17): 'use the maximum resources possible, but stay cost constrained; brainstorm new ideas automatically; keep increasing scope and loops'. Ultrastable proposes, scores and queues its own spinoffs and loop scope increases against the free-plan headroom the FREE-TIER-1 governor measures (ops/free-tier.json). Read by foundation/ideas.py; checked by `python3 -m foundation ideas --check`. Numbers are hypotheses re-tuned from settled outcomes; never edit one to clear a breach.

cadence._doc: launches per day by governor level; a stale snapshot counts as degrade

bank.name: Free-Tier Meter
bank.tagline: How much of Cloudflare's free plan does a whole autonomous system use today? Live, from the loop that spends it.
bank.showcases: the budget governor: doing the most with the least

bank.name: Ultrastable by the Numbers
bank.tagline: Loops running, edges wired, stories passing and what the system does not know yet, straight from its own ledger.

bank.name: What Changed
bank.tagline: Every change the system made to itself, by who or what originated it. No person in the path.
bank.showcases: provenance: where every change came from

bank.name: Loop Ledger
bank.tagline: How many closed loops keep this system running, and which ones are on a clock.

bank.name: Spinoff Portfolio
bank.tagline: The apps Ultrastable launched on its own, what they cost and how many it retired.
bank.showcases: autonomous idea-to-app launching with a portfolio manager

bank.name: security.txt Writer
bank.tagline: Answer three choices, get a ready RFC 9116 security.txt. Closes the gap Blindspot Check finds.
bank.showcases: check, fix, re-check: the loop closed for a stranger

bank.name: SPF and DMARC Writer
bank.tagline: Pick your mail provider, get the exact SPF and DMARC records to publish.
bank.showcases: check, fix, re-check: the loop closed for a stranger

bank.name: Plain Privacy Page Draft
bank.tagline: A few choices become a plain-language privacy page draft. Not legal advice; says so.
bank.showcases: blind-spot register turned into a product

bank.name: Country Snapshot
bank.tagline: Type a country code, see its latest World Bank figures for electricity, drinking water, internet use and literacy.
bank.showcases: an open public-data dashboard for any country
bank.need_evidence: The World Bank publishes these for 200+ economies; gaps in basic services are the core development measures. Need is a stated judgment.

bank.name: Air Quality Check
bank.tagline: Type a city anywhere, see its air quality right now and the current particle levels, from open forecast data.
bank.need_evidence: Outdoor air pollution is a leading environmental cause of early death worldwide per WHO. Need is a stated judgment.

bank.name: Quake Watch
bank.tagline: Significant earthquakes anywhere in the world this week, read live from the USGS, with a link to each event page.
bank.showcases: global hazard awareness from open data
bank.need_evidence: Earthquakes strike on every continent; the feed is worldwide. Need is a stated judgment.

bank.name: Access Check
bank.tagline: Name any website, get a plain read of basic accessibility signals on its home page: language, alt text, labels, zoom.
bank.need_evidence: WHO estimates about 1.3 billion people live with a significant disability; inaccessible sites exclude them. Need is a stated judgment.

scope_templates.why: three queued ideas with the highest impact are blocked only by this archetype; it adds no storage and no model calls

scope_templates.title: Collect every live app's metrics twice a day instead of once
scope_templates.why: more measurement points per app for the portfolio manager at a few requests

scope_templates.title: Refresh every status board's facts on each loop run, not only on launch
scope_templates.why: boards stay current for free; the bundle is rebuilt from committed files

scope_templates.title: Check every live app against its own claims once a day
scope_templates.why: words match code at the cost of a request per claim

scope_templates.title: Add scout sources while neurons sit under the reserve
scope_templates.why: neuron headroom is the least used free resource

benefit._doc: BENEFIT-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-18: 'How are you measuring public benefit?'). Public-benefit score of an idea = scale * region * need * use, then divided by (1 + cost_penalty * cost_share) like every idea. region: how many people in how many places it can serve (global or 3+ regions 1.0, two regions 0.7, one country 0.4). need: 1-5 size of the unmet need, a stated hypothesis with its evidence in the idea. use: measured, 0.5 to 1.5 from the app's uses_7d once the metrics ledger has it; unmeasured is 1.0, never zero. Hypotheses re-tuned from settled outcomes; never edit a number to clear a breach.
